en:
Yes, it's true, Kaito never put
his arm through his sleeve...

...but that was just his <CLT=cltSTRONG>right arm<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
He wore his left sleeve normally.

And the <CLT=cltSTRONG>left sleeve<CLT=cltNORMAL> was the one
we found outside the press.

Knowing how Kaito wore his coat,
that's awfully strange, isn't it?

Then maybe neither of his arms were
through the sleeves.
Huh?

It's a possibility... In the end, your
reasoning is full of holes.

Stop getting in my way.
I have to defeat Kokichi.
<CLT=cltMIND>Maki... What's really going on?

<CLT=cltMIND>Seems you've made up your mind
that Kaito is definitely dead.
<CLT=cltMIND>But why would you do that?

It's like Maki said, though...
Kaito's gotta be the victim.

Cuz if Kokichi, the mastermind, was 
dead, the killing game would be over.
Yeah, that's true.

Monokuma, hurry up and bring Kokichi here.
We already know who the victim is.
Huh? Already? You sure it's not too soon?

We need the suspect present now that
he's the subject of our discussion.
Gotcha. I guess I'll bring him out now.
Hey Mister Suspect! That's your cue!
An <CLT=cltSTRONG>Exisal<CLT=cltNORMAL>!?
Wh-What!? Why is an Exisal here!?

Haha, whoops! My bad. Seems like I 
gave you guys a scare, huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>...What is this?
Is that...<CLT=cltSTRONG>Kaito<CLT=cltNORMAL>'s voice!?
...Kaito?

There was a lot going on, so I just
hid in an Exisal and kinda dozed off.

Haha, and that's why I'm so late!
Anyway, what's goin' on, guys?

H-Hold on. Then the one
that died wasn't Kaito—
Stuuupid! That was just a lie!

Ah-haha, you guys thought I died!?
I would never! Noooo way!
K-<CLT=cltSTRONG>Kokichi<CLT=cltNORMAL>!?

"I'm gonna live till I die!
I'm gonna laugh 'stead of cry!"
Wow, that's old! How old are you!?

I thought as much... Your appearance right
now is fit for a lowly asshole like you.

Nee-heehee... You're making me blush!
You're getting so angry over me.
Is that really you, Kokichi!?
That's right, Cracker Jack!
Seriously, how old are you!?

Then why are you hiding in there?
Show yourself!

Oh, this is more for self-defense. Little Miss
Crankypants would kill me if I showed myself.

I understand how you guys must feel. You
can't believe it because I'm like this, right?

Nee-heehee... That's what I thought.
In that case, I brought <CLT=cltSTRONG>evidence<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
...Evidence?
Tadaaa! The <CLT=cltSTRONG>video camera<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

It was in the warehouse but I brought it
to the hangar, just in case.

Man, that was a smart move! Thanks to this,
I filmed it so everyone could see it clearly.
The <CLT=cltSTRONG>moment the victim died<CLT=cltNORMAL>...
Nyeh!? Wh-What did you say!?
Alrighty then! Let's watch this shocking moment!

Heeey, Monokuma! Can you connect the 
video camera to the monitor?
Roger that!

<CLT=cltMIND>Monokuma grabbed the camera from the Exisal,
hooked it up to the court room's monitor...
<CLT=cltMIND>and played the tape for us.
...Huh?
K-Kaito!?

Th-This is terrible! Why would...
something like this...?

I-I saw it through my fingers...
The moment...Kaito was crushed...
I'm...gonna... *huuurk*

By the way, I'd like to add that this footage
has not been doctored in any way!

This video camera only has the
basic functions...

Just the Play, Record, and Pause buttons,
so you can't edit after filming it.

And of course, I didn't upload it to a 
computer to edit it either.
Riiiight, Monokuma?

Oh, you can talk. Your answer is necessary
for a fair discussion.

I see! If it's necessary for a fair discussion,
then I will answer!

No trace of that footage was found on any
of the computers inside the academy!

See? If it wasn't connected to any computer,
then editing the footage would be impossible.
Which means, this footage is 100% real!

If that's the case...then it would seem our
suspicions can be lifted.

The body we found inside the hangar, crushed
in the hydraulic press, is definitely Kaito!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Murder Video<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been recorded in the
Monopad. View it from the Truth Bullet menu.

<CLT=cltMIND>Was that...?
Was that really him?

Poor Kaito... I can't believe he 
died such a horrible death...

I can't believe he died with his guts and 
his brains splattered all over that machine!

S-Stop it... Now I'm starting to
not feel well...

That's probably cuz I used my magic 
to transfer all my barf over to you.

I know that's a joke, but the
thought of it... *huuurp*

<CLT=cltMIND>...Why?
Why was...Kaito...killed?

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi had no reason
to kill Kaito...

<CLT=cltMIND>He had just told us all that he was the
mastermind, that the killing game was over.

<CLT=cltMIND>So what would he gain
by killing Kaito?

Nee-heehee... It looks like you finally 
believe that I'm the one in this Exisal.

Yes. With that, we can definitively say
that the culprit is...
...you.
Huh? Why?

You filmed the moment the victim died, which
means you were present at the scene...

As the person who filmed this footage, you're
the only one who could be the culprit!

But if the culprit shot the video, why would
they go out of their way to show it—
Aw maaan, ya got me. Yeah, I'm the culprit.
<CLT=cltMIND>...What?
Geez, I totally dug my own grave!

Here's the truth—I decided to participate in
this trial in an Exisal after I killed Kaito.

Of course, it was mostly to make the victim
unknown, to jazz up this trial!

I took that footage for proof, so I could reveal
it after you guys get the correct answer...

But...ah-haha! I toootally spaced out!
I wasn't supposed to show it right away!

So does that mean...you admit
to the crime?
Oh, man! I dug my own grave again!?

Well, I don't think you guys will believe
any of the excuses I make now...
So...I give up!

You're giving up? Does...that mean
it's been decided?
Is it okay that this trial was so short?

That's fine. We knew from the very start
that Kokichi was the killer.

But before we vote, I want to say
something to Kokichi...

You may be the mastermind, but I won't let
you escape after you violated the rules.

That would desecrate the killing game
Junko Enoshima created, right?
...Your beloved Junko Enoshima.
Junko...?

Whatever! It's Voting Time now!
Let's go before Kokichi changes his—
No, hold on a second! This isn't right!

The culprit comes in, confesses
to the crime, and the trial ends?
That's not how this goes!

That doesn't sound like the kind of game
Kokichi or Monokuma or Junko would play!

What if the mastermind got tired of it?
The Remnants of Despair were like tha—

No, if they were tired of it, they wouldn't
have put all that effort into the video.

There would have been no need for
this class trial in the first place.

Something's not right. We need to
get a better feel for this situation.

I think...Kokichi has some sort of plan.
He's trying to trap us.

Trap us? Are you saying Kokichi isn't
the culprit?

Then, are you suggesting one of us is 
the culprit?
<CLT=cltMIND>What?

If it's not Kokichi, then the culprit must be
one of us...
One of us?
That's not possible!

No, I didn't say that! I was just saying
it's dangerous to trust Kokichi—
Nee-heehee... Shuichi is so distrusting...

But it's exaaactly like Shuichi said!
I'm actually nooot the culprit!
<CLT=cltMIND>...Seriously?

Wh-What? But that contradicts what you
said previously.

Yuppers, that was a <CLT=cltSTRONG>lie<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Sorry! I lied again.

The real culprit of this case is super bad at
hiding themselves, so I thought I could help...

I pretended to be the culprit by using the 
footage! It made the game more interesting, too!
A-Are you serious?

Nyeeeh! What's the truth and what's
a lie!? I don't know anymore!
It's fine... Because Kokichi is the culprit.

He killed Kaito... No matter how much he
deceives us, it won't change our minds.

The footage shows he did it!
Kokichi has to be the only option!
<CLT=cltMIND>The only option?

<CLT=cltMIND>Is that really true?
Are we just going to leave it at that?
